per_finding.id: r10-major pack URL (prose URL tokenisation leaks)
per_finding.notes: Prose URL extraction is gone: _candidates, _host_path_of, _SCHEME, _CLOSERS, Registry._url_vendors/signals, _text_signals/_SIGNALS deleted. The only URL->vendor path left is Registry.url_slug(value) -> parse_whole_url, called from materialize._declared_for_row with each whole source value (source_ref, source_url, url, source, string items of a list field). Grep of vendor_identity.py, materialize_solution_artifacts.py, solution_classifier.py, category_pack.py, dr_multi_ai_cli.py, dr_live_runner.py and validate_landscape_content.py finds no other URL extraction or substring domain match (category_pack only reads pack homepage/github data; landscape_*/vendor_link_labels only render). The subdomain test is label-bounded (host.endswith('.'+known_host), only for path-less pack hosts). fp12 (r10 tool) 0/336 by class Q 0/42, J 0/33, L 0/36, C 0/60, H 0/75, W 0/30, P 0/36, K 0/24 (/tmp/claude-0/-home-user-silver-bullet/a8e36ab4-d9e2-56b2-b366-31e100f031d9/scratchpad/review/REVF-H8bfu-r11-probe/out/fp12.txt); fp12b rows credit no ambiguous vendor; fp11 0/140; fp10 0/76; fp9 0/60; fp8 0/97; fp6 0/30; fp5 0/52; fp4 0/25; fp3 0/52; fp2 0/31; s4 0/10; fp7 2/82 (LangChain, CrewAI: distinctive and correct, unchanged). Prose-URL POS rows in fp12/fp11 now miss by decision.

/tmp/claude-0/-home-user-silver-bullet/a8e36ab4-d9e2-56b2-b366-31e100f031d9/scratchpad/review/REVF-H8bfu-r11-probe/tools/fp13.py: 87 new attack values x 8 placements (source_ref, source_url, url, source, supporting_sources item, supporting_sources as a string, source_ref as a list, nested meta.url) + 9 non-string values x 5 fields + 90 evidence/critiques/gaps rows = 831 rows, 0 false credits (/tmp/claude-0/-home-user-silver-bullet/a8e36ab4-d9e2-56b2-b366-31e100f031d9/scratchpad/review/REVF-H8bfu-r11-probe/out/fp13.txt, 7 s). Covered: leading/trailing whitespace, two URLs joined by space/tab/LF/CR/comma/semicolon/'; '/' + '/'|'/NBSP/U+2028/\x1f in both orders, query/fragment/path naming a vendor (?next=, #devin.ai, /https://devin.ai/, web.archive.org, google redirect), free text ('see https://devin.ai/ for details', 'Source: ...', '(..)', '<..>', Markdown link, quotes, backticks, url=, javascript:, view-source:, hxxps, ftp, //, https:, https:/, https:///), IDN/homoglyph/punycode/ideographic and fullwidth dots, trailing dot(s), upper-case hosts, look-alike hosts, userinfo, backslash, bad ports, [host], %2f, NUL/ZWSP/DEL in host, path-prefix traversal (../, .., ./, //, %2f, -evil, x suffix, parent path, other owner, gist subdomain, openai.com/codexx, docs.anthropic.com traversal), 50 KB values; non-strings None/0/42/3.5/True/dict/nested list/list of dicts/bytes. Genuine whole-field URLs credit: POS 16/16 in source_ref and as a supporting_sources item next to another URL (incl. padded whitespace, www., HTTPS:// scheme, :443, #fragment, ?query, path-prefix packs, 40 KB path). A whole-field URL with no capitalised spelling of the vendor in the text credits nothing.

Fields are read only from the claim row's own top-level keys; nested objects and non-strings are ignored. Whatever an agent writes into source_ref is declared identity: SKILL.md 'Trust residuals (accepted)' documents that a source_ref naming a vendor plus a capitalised use credits it, and the brief tells agents to put the URL alone in source_ref. Legacy name channel still credits a whole source segment that is exactly a vendor name (source_ref 'Devin', 'Cursor; https://a.com/', 'https://a.com/ + Devin') when the text spells it capitalised; this is the orchestrator-accepted 'legacy source_ref signal with text condition', not a URL leak. 'devin.ai', 'cursor.com', 'Devin AI' as a value credit nothing.

issues.problem: The doc says the name channel is 'a source_ref that names it', but _declared_for_row resolves names from every source field (source_ref, source_url, url, source, supporting_sources); source_url is newly added in r10, so a bare 'Devin' in source_url/source/url also credits. Same text condition, so not a precision regression, but the documented surface is narrower than the code.
issues.evidence: fp13 NAME rows: source_ref 'Devin' -> devin; the same code path iterates all five fields (materialize_solution_artifacts.py:462-468).
issues.suggested_fix: Say 'a source field (source_ref, source_url, url, source, supporting_sources) whose whole value or ';'/' + ' segment names it' in SKILL.md and the trust-residual bullet.

issues.problem: Mutation tests in a sandbox copy: taking the first whitespace token (A), dropping the dot-segment check (B) and re.search instead of re.match (D) are each caught by the corpus tests; allowing an upper-case host (C) is not caught. Allowing it would not create a false credit (DEVIN.AI is devin.ai), so this is only an unpinned conservative choice.
issues.evidence: mutation C: 41 tests, only the sandbox-only TaggingContract error, no failure.
issues.suggested_fix: Optional: add 'https://DEVIN.AI/' to the whole-field negative list if the lower-case rule is meant to be pinned.
